title: .bom-orch.json — per-project configuration, read only from the baseline commit
description: Roadmap §3.6 / WS0 §5. The server reads this file with `git show <baselineCommit>:.bom-orch.json`; the worktree copy and the working-tree copy are never consulted, and the path is on the security hard list so a delegate touching it is a policy failure. Strict JSON, <=64 KiB, UTF-8, additionalProperties false at every level.

schemaVersion.description: A newer version than the server knows is refused with reasonCode config_schema_newer (roadmap §5.9).

command.description: argv, no shell. First element is the executable name. Overrides deriveTestCommand. Consumed by WS4a.

cwd.description: Working directory of the test child, relative to the repository root; `..`, backslashes and control characters are forbidden. `.`, `./` and the empty string all mean the repository root. It must already exist inside the evidence worktree - the server creates no directory there - and the pinned definitions are still read from the repository root.

reporter.description: Trusted-evidence adapter this run requires. Omit for automatic selection; `none` turns the automatic selection off. `node-events`, `pytest-events` and `dotnet-trx` are injected by the server, so naming one the derived command cannot produce disables machine evidence for the run and says so in a notice.

resultsPath.description: Relative path of the reporter output, resolved against the REPOSITORY ROOT of the evidence worktree - not against tests.cwd, so a producer that runs in a subdirectory has to be told to write here. Required when reporter is junit-xml, and read only for that reporter: the three injected adapters (node-events, pytest-events, dotnet-trx) are handed a server-owned path on the command line, so this key would be validated and dropped for them. Same character policy as cwd: `..`, backslashes and control characters are forbidden on every platform, because a backslash is a separator on Windows and an ordinary filename character elsewhere. For junit-xml it may name a FILE or a DIRECTORY: Gradle and Maven Surefire write one TEST-<FQCN>.xml per test class, and a directory is read by enumerating TEST-*.xml in byte order and summing the documents.

timeoutMs.description: Upper bound of one test execution. The run's own remaining budget still applies: whichever of the two is smaller wins.

provisionDeps.description: Opt-in dependency provisioning (roadmap §3.6). lockfile-install runs the package manager's lockfile install with lifecycle scripts disabled, from the baseline, before the writer ever runs.

allow.description: Project allowlist of expected-change globs (POSIX style, ** allowed). Union with the per-call scope_allow argument. Security hard-list paths (including this file) are ignored even if listed. Consumed by WS5.

writer.description: Project-level writer pin. Precedence: per-call writer > this > global settings.ini. Consumed by WS7.
